integrity: Self-contained proof and executable finite checker supplied. No independent mathematical review or audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete multipartite graphs only; counts only minimizing named singleton rainbow functions, not every weight; arbitrary unequal part sizes are not settled. title: Exact singleton rainbow domination and optimal-function census on balanced multipartite graphs
